reports.title: JBT Marel Corporation Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Announces Increased Share Repurchase Authorization

lines: For the full year 2026, JBT Marel expects year-over-year consolidated revenue growth of approximately 5 percent at the midpoint, which is inclusive of approximately 1.5 percent foreign exchange translation benefit.
Full year 2026 total depreciation and amortization is expected to be approximately $261 million.
